kurallar: Sources: GeckoTerminal new and trending pools on 13 chains, DexScreener profiles and boosts; every token re-read on DexScreener. Tokens that fail the safety gate are not listed. Only pools from the last 7 days with at least $5K liquidity and $5K 24 h volume ($1K / $500 on Arc and Elysium). A token stays 24 h after it was last seen.

kontrolAciklama.guvenlik: RugCheck on Solana; GoPlus and honeypot.is on EVM chains: mint/freeze rights, honeypot, taxes, holder concentration. Failures are never listed; lesser findings show as a warning.
kontrolAciklama.talep: Unique buyers in the last hour are at least 1.5× the day's hourly average, and at least 10.
kontrolAciklama.genislik: No more than 3 buys per buyer in the last hour: the buying is spread over many wallets, not a few repeating.
kontrolAciklama.derinlik: Pool liquidity is at least 10% of the market cap and at least $10K ($2K on Arc and Elysium).
kontrolAciklama.denge: At least as many buyers as sellers in the last hour.
